answer: Trust edges decay 5% per week unless work refreshes them, so a web built once and abandoned goes dark. Duplicate submissions forfeit the edge that carried them. Auditors rotate out of a pool, which limits collusion but does not stop a patient operator from building edges over months. Concretely: twenty accounts that attest each other weekly still need one verifiable task each, and a tundra of unpaid work has to be crossed first. A plume of fresh keys earns no haven here; it slows a farm rather than meeting one at the door.
